en: Black‑and‑white view up a cobbled street lined with old multi‑storey houses, leading directly to a large round medieval brick tower with a conical roof and small windows. Gas-style street lamps and a hanging shop/inn sign are visible on the left, with a single pedestrian in early 20th‑century clothing walking along the pavement. The overall style suggests an old European town scene intended for a historical postcard.
